description: A chocolate company can transport their boxes of chocolate either using their own vans or by renting trucks. Their vans can transport 50 boxes per trip while a truck can transport 80 boxes per trip. Since they own their vans, the cost per van trip is $30 while the cost per truck trip is $50. The company needs to transport at least 1500 boxes of chocolate and they have a budget of $1000. Since the vans also provide advertising, the number of trips by van must be larger than the number of trips by trucks. How many of trip by each should be done to minimize the total number of trips?

VanCapacity.definition: Capacity of a van in boxes per trip

TruckCapacity.definition: Capacity of a truck in boxes per trip

VanCost.definition: Cost per van trip in dollars

TruckCost.definition: Cost per truck trip in dollars

MinBoxes.definition: Minimum number of boxes to transport

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of trips made by vans and trucks combined"

constraints.description: 50 * (number of van trips) + 80 * (number of truck trips) >= 1500
30 * (number of van trips) + 50 * (number of truck trips) <= 1000
Number of van trips must be greater than the number of truck trips
Number of van trips and number of truck trips must be non-negative integers
